headline: A 2005 executive order on how federal agencies share terrorism-related information to protect people in the United States.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order sets rules meant to strengthen how the government shares information about terrorism. The word "further" suggests it builds on earlier efforts on the same topic. No summary was provided, so the specific steps it requires are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that handle terrorism information
who_it_affects.how: The order likely shapes how these agencies share terrorism-related information.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed October 25, 2005; executive orders usually take effect when signed unless they say otherwise.
